title: fix(plugin-email): a name an enabled and a disabled package hold sends what it sends when only the enabled one holds it

The card stays open: its `_env` half is #33385 (area E1, still open). This PR is the "separate, declared move" that #33361's acceptance notes and its contract review (record 6882047833, item ③) left owed once #32354 landed. #32354 landed in #33405 (merged 2026-11-14T22:08Z, before #33361).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：邮件模板名有一个持有包被停用、只剩一个在服务的持有包时，发送（经元数据协议的执行列表）改为读环境级列表，与"只有这一个包持有该名"时完全一致；另把 `servedBundleAddressOf` 中不可达的环境项分支改为"找不到模板"（复审 nit N1）。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 D3「停用的包不持有任何名字」。#32354（#33405）落地后，环境级列表已不再列出停用包一侧的成员（自身项、定制对行、依赖包追加的语言），所以地址可以只按在服务持有包数量来选；此前读该包自己的地址，会漏掉依赖它的包追加的语言。
- 风险与回滚：只在有持有包被停用、且只剩一个在服务持有包时生效。实测唯一变化：该持有包的定制对行与依赖包追加语言落在同一语言时，答案从定制对行变为依赖包的语言，与停用包根本不持有该名时的答案相同。没有包停用时、或无协议只读注册表时，答案不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-loader.ts` 的 `servedBundleAddressOf`（`onServedCount` 与 `servedCountDecides` 参数）以及 `readBundle` 中 `viaProtocol` 的传入；`template-loader.test.ts` 中 `two holders, BETA disabled` 一例的期望与新的 `one holder` CONTROL。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email exec vitest run src/template-loader.test.ts`，预期 80 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地

## What changes

`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-loader.ts`, `servedBundleAddressOf` (the branch taken only while a holder of the name is disabled):

- **The address is chosen on the served count when the bundle is read from the protocol's execution list.** One served holder ⇒ the environment-wide list (`undefined`), two or more ⇒ the answering holder's own address, exactly as `bundleAddressOf` chooses on the holder count when nothing is disabled. This applies to both answers that read a package's bundle: the name resolving to a served holder, and the closure re-resolve (a caller holding an addition only, or the built-ins for an `auth.*` name).
- **Why it is safe now:** since #33405 (#32354) the environment-wide execution list holds no member of a disabled holder's side: its own items were already filtered, and the list naming no package now withholds its customization pair's rows and a dependent's added bundle members. So the read beside a disabled holder answers what it answers when that holder holds nothing of the name.
- **The registry's own list keeps the per-holder address.** `registry.listItems` (read only when no protocol is registered) withholds neither, so there the move would leak a dependent's addition to the disabled holder (measured, see the second ablation). `readBundle` passes `viaProtocol` into `bundleAddressOf` as `servedCountDecides`.
- **Nit N1:** the environment-item branch (`resolved.holder.kind` other than `package`) now answers `NO_BUNDLE` instead of the environment-wide read. It is unreachable while a holder is disabled (a name a package holds resolves to no environment item), so no answer moves; "no read is made beside a disabled holder for it" now holds by construction.
- Doc comments on `bundleAddressOf` and `servedBundleAddressOf` restate the rule. Changeset: `@objectstack/plugin-email` patch.

### Moved answers

Probe: the #33361 world (a real `SchemaRegistry` and the protocol's real `getMetaItemsForExecution` over stored rows), 8 disabled states × 2 registration orders × 2 reads × 9 callers × 2 locales = 1,152 answers, on `babd5d4a` (FROM, `main`) and on this branch (TO), plus the same worlds with the disabled package's side removed instead of disabled (ABSENT: it ships nothing of the name; for ALPHA also no pair row and no dependent's addition).

| Read | State | Caller | Locale | FROM | TO | ABSENT |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| protocol | two holders, BETA disabled (ALPHA carries a pair row and a dependent's addition, both fr-FR) | omitted, null, ALPHA, BOTH, VIA_ALPHA, ADDER | fr-FR | the pair's row (`PAIR fr-FR`) | the dependent's addition (`ADDER fr-FR`) | `ADDER fr-FR` |

12 answers move (6 callers × 2 orders), all toward the ABSENT answer; 0 of the 1,152 move away from it. The answers that still differ from ABSENT number 204 (216 on FROM), and every one is a declared row of #33361: the disabled package's own send (row 36), the environment's item or a package-less stored row beside a name only a disabled package holds (row 37), and the registry-only read (below). With nothing disabled the code path is unchanged (`bundleAddressOf`'s first branch), and the pinned CONTROLs hold.

## Tests

`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-loader.test.ts`, describe `a disabled package holds no name at the send (ADR-0150 D3, #32670)`:

- The `two holders, BETA disabled` case's protocol expectations move fr-FR from `PAIR fr-FR` to `ADDER fr-FR` for the six callers above (its registry-read override is unchanged: `no template`).
- A new CONTROL, state `one holder` (ALPHA alone holds the name, nothing disabled), pins the answers the BETA-disabled case must equal for every caller but BETA itself. 1 case × 2 orders × 2 reads = 4 new tests; the file runs 80 (76 on `main`).

## Acceptance notes

- **The registry-only read keeps a disabled-vs-absent difference.** With no protocol registered and BETA disabled, a fr-FR send for ALPHA's callers answers `no template` (ALPHA's own address, which the registry list narrows by `_packageId`), where ABSENT answers `ADDER fr-FR`. The move cannot be applied there because `registry.listItems` still lists a dependent's addition to a disabled holder (ablation 2 measures the leak). A host with no protocol has no metadata door; noted, not filed.
- **The moved answer prefers the dependent's addition over the holder's pair row at the same locale.** That is `main`'s answer for a name one package holds with nothing disabled (the new CONTROL, both orders, and #33361's R4-F note), not a rule this PR adds: the move only makes the disabled case equal to it.
- **Not in this PR:** the `_env` cell of #32183 row 17 (#33385, area E1, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/**`) and the R4-G flow doors, as #33361 recorded. So `Part of #32670`, not a closing line.
- The probe files were temporary and are not committed.
